VBO:0200262.summary: Described by keepers as loyal and alert, the Bully Kutta also has a reputation for dominance and aggression. Bhupi and fellow enthusiasts formed their Indian Bully Dog group in 2018 to preserve the population, whose work includes guarding farms and premises.
